p.description: Sizeable Group Use Campsite at the back edge of the Alberta foothills. Gives an amazing view of the forested valley below and the Rocky Mountains to the West
The campground has vault toilets, and there is no firewood or drinking water available on site.

Mount Michener south summit is the second highest summit of the massif, and can be ascended from the west, or as in this case, traversed to from the north via multiple difficult exposed downclimbs.  T
Mount Michener official summit (albeit the lowest summit on the massif)
Open June 2 - September 1st. Rough road into the camp ground as of 2025.
